title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: This is me. My name is Wang Lin.
I like playing football and reading books.

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。

sentences.en: I'm good at maths, but not good at art.
sentences.zh: 我擅长数学，但不擅长美术。

sentences.en: I have many friends at school.
